answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The result is a self-purifying economy: every epoch, low-cost fake identities are filtered out by the same reputation mechanics that reward the honest ones.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a oasis as the anchor of the cost. A quill stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a lotus holds the reputation...
